_comment: Optional per-deployment branding, shared by the HOAST player landing page and the telemetry dashboard (:8090). Mount your filled copy at /brand.json (see docker-compose.override.yml.example). Every key is optional; when the file is absent both pages stay generic. Player text values are HTML. vodDownloads OVERRIDES the built-in default download links (derived from the release pinned in services/loop-source/fetch-demo-content.sh); omit it to keep those.

_comment_telemetry: host and boxLinks brand the telemetry dashboard's launcher buttons. host is this deployment's reachable address (a Tailscale name or an IP); omit it and the buttons fall back to whatever address the dashboard was opened on. boxLinks overrides the built-in button list (label + port + path, all resolved on host); omit it to keep the defaults shown below. Do not use TEL_HOST for this: it is only a display label.
_comment_guestDisclaimer: Shown under the player ONLY while a guest session holds the endpoint (GUEST_ENABLED deployments). short = one line by the badge, full = the complete notice; en + pl because GDPR notices are expected in the server's local language. affiliationNotice is a reserved slot for an institutional line; leave empty until agreed.

en.short: Open test endpoint: this stream was submitted by a third party.
en.full:
Open test endpoint. Anyone may broadcast to this endpoint. Streams are submitted by third parties and are not reviewed before they appear. Sessions end automatically after three hours.

To report a stream, contact <operator email>. Reported streams are reviewed and removed where appropriate.

Connection details, including IP address, are logged for the purpose of operating and moderating the service, and are retained for 30 days.

If you report a stream, your IP address is logged with the report to prevent abuse of the reporting function, and is retained under the same 30-day rule.

pl.short: Otwarty punkt testowy: ta transmisja pochodzi od osoby trzeciej.
pl.full:
Otwarty punkt testowy. Każdy może nadawać na ten punkt. Transmisje są przesyłane przez osoby trzecie i nie są sprawdzane przed ich pojawieniem się. Sesje kończą się automatycznie po trzech godzinach.

Aby zgłosić transmisję, napisz na adres <e-mail operatora>. Zgłoszone transmisje są sprawdzane i w uzasadnionych przypadkach usuwane.

Szczegóły połączenia, w tym adres IP, są rejestrowane w celu obsługi i moderacji usługi oraz przechowywane przez 30 dni.

W przypadku zgłoszenia transmisji adres IP zgłaszającego jest rejestrowany wraz ze zgłoszeniem w celu zapobiegania nadużyciom funkcji zgłaszania i przechowywany zgodnie z tą samą zasadą 30 dni.
